text:
sam: Postmortem follow-up — recurring pattern: accept handshake timeouts -> truncated streams -> reconnect storms. Need owners for fixes and dates. Quick replies.

ivy: I'll take server telemetry + hypothesis. Plan: add p95/p99 accept-queue and per-worker socket counts. ETA Mon.

dan: I'll own client SDK backoff and max-conns. Will add exponential backoff with capped jitter and beta releases for node/python. ETA Wed.

sam: Also need a partial-detection sentinel emitted by the runtime. Ivy, can you add that metric and a log marker?

ivy: Yes — will emit "stream.partial" when connection closes without EOS and add a sample log line.

eng-infra: We can provision a 3-shard staging harness. Please file INF ticket with QPS and duration.

dan: SDK will expose stream.on('partial') and only auto-retry when idempotent. I'll post snippet.

sam: Canary window: 01:00-05:00 UTC Thu. Rollback if partial_rate > 2x baseline or total errors +0.5%.

ivy: I'll add Grafana panels and alert rules for stream.accept.queue and stream.partial_rate.

ci-bot: Canary scheduled -> 3333340000 targeting staging-1..3 :rocket:

sam: I'll draft a short runbook "Investigate truncated streams" and set weekly follow-ups until closed.

ivy: ack.

dan: ack.

eng-infra: ack — created INF-5001 for harness quota.

sam: Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
